scope: Exactly 27 whole requires-only ordinary-goal candidates, complete current P profiles/cases and existing prerequisite context; plus bounded rereview of the anchor English-only v2 correction.
independence: Author whole goals and P metadata were visible. Old peer conclusions were not used to decide these deltas. No old450 goal review was restarted. No author route-score conclusion was accepted as scientific evidence.

finding.beforeFinding: The German orientation offers curiosity/continuation without checking subject detail. The original English instead demands that the learner explain chemistry relevance and durable competence growth. A bilingual non-assessing prerequisite claim is therefore inconsistent.
finding.actualBoundedRereview: Read both complete before/candidate anchor objects in the v2 author package. The only delta is descriptionEn. The candidate faithfully conveys possibilities in everyday life, social participation, study and work; curiosity/continuation choice; no required or assessed subject detail. It removes the competence-performance demand and the durable-growth explanation claim.
finding.completionBoundary: An interest label alone still does not complete orientation. AGENTS.md requires tailored motivational follow-up or explicit wish to leave, positive coach closure and a further learner answer agreeing to close. This text-only translation changes none of those rules.

perGoalDecisions.title: Waschvorgänge beeinflussen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Washing conditions offer an everyday entry into sustainable consumption.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The supplied concentration/hardness/temperature cases still demand micelle/dispersion reasoning, calcium-soap balance and controlled comparisons. The orientation does not certify surfactant knowledge or reinstate a blanket surfactant prerequisite.

perGoalDecisions.title: Peptidbindungen erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Peptide chemistry connects the subject to food, proteins and later study.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The existing amino-acid cluster requirement remains exact. Formal condensation, free termini and resonance/planarity still need chemical evidence; an interest choice supplies none of that evidence.

perGoalDecisions.title: Brønsted-Konzept anwenden
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Acid-base behaviour is a concrete everyday topic for a curiosity-based introduction.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The existing symbols/formulas prerequisite remains. HF/NH3 and charged phosphate-ampholyte cases still require proton roles, pairs, atom/charge balance and species/solution distinctions. The same anchor is explicitly visible in the Sek-I composition view.

perGoalDecisions.title: Biotreibstoffe nach Rohstoff und Herstellungsweg unterscheiden
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Fuel feedstocks and production routes connect chemistry to energy decisions.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Complete hb200 oil/FAME/ethanol data, seed balance and wood/syngas transfer remain operative. No climate-neutrality shortcut, LK-only full FT requirement for GK, manufacture duty or new chemistry dependency is introduced.

perGoalDecisions.title: Magensäurebildung und Protonenpumpen-Hemmer erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: An introduction can connect chemical models to questions about stomach acid and medicines.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The full supplied pump/transport model, NCI mechanism dossier and two acid-balance cases remain; neutralisation is distinguished from secretion inhibition. Orientation creates no clinical evidence or personal treatment recommendation.

perGoalDecisions.title: Treibhauseffekt über die Strahlungsbilanz erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Climate participation supplies a fitting motivation for Earth-energy-balance chemistry.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The fossil-CO2/carbon-cycle prerequisite stays exact. Complete hb199 fluxes, absorption/emission, held conditions and changed-albedo transfer remain required; the new edge does not treat stock increase as proof of the IR mechanism.

perGoalDecisions.title: Chemische Quellen und Darstellungen kritisch prüfen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Social participation is a direct context for evaluating chemistry claims and sources.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Vendor/laboratory/anonymous and solubility/marketing/theory cases remain complete with source-intention, method and scope checks. No compulsory independent research or particular chemical topic is invented as a prerequisite.

perGoalDecisions.title: Nukleophile Substitution als Donator-Akzeptor-Reaktion beschreiben
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: An introduction can connect molecular change to the possibilities of organic synthesis.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The supplied electron-pair donor/acceptor models still require correct arrows, leaving groups and atom/charge balance. Orientation does not certify Lewis-model competence or imply a universal SN1/SN2 mechanism.

perGoalDecisions.title: Einflussfaktoren diskutieren
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Controlling reaction rates provides an accessible connection to everyday processes and technology.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: All four factors, controlled particle-level comparisons and enzyme/third-substance transfers remain intact. No quantitative universal rate law or additional experimental execution is inferred from the new prerequisite.

perGoalDecisions.title: Wirkungsgrade vergleichen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Energy conversion is relevant to everyday choices and later technical work.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The existing vegetable-oil-fuels cluster requirement remains unchanged. Whole energy20-13 materials retain explicit useful-service/system boundaries, uncertainty and common-service comparison. Motivation neither certifies those calculations nor chooses a universal winner.

perGoalDecisions.title: Elektrophile Addition mechanistisch darstellen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: The relevance of making and changing materials can motivate electrophilic-addition models.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The ethene/HBr and fresh propene/HBr cases retain electron arrows, plausible intermediates, ionic/no-peroxide conditions and bounded major-product claims. No previously removed blanket mechanism prerequisite is restored.

perGoalDecisions.title: Gesellschaftliche Folgen der Wirkstoffentwicklung historisch und aktuell bewerten
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Medicines and equitable access directly fit the anchor’s societal-participation purpose.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The complete historical/current hb232 comparison and resistance transfer retain benefit/access/cost/safety/evidence limits. An interest choice is not an efficacy finding, historical causal proof or treatment recommendation.

perGoalDecisions.title: Qualitätskontrolle von Arzneimitteln an Belegen beurteilen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Product quality is a concrete bridge from chemistry to social participation and work.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The existing data-documentation cluster prerequisite stays exact. Analysis, documented GMP and general statutory purpose remain distinct in the complete dossiers; orientation supplies no batch release or legal/clinical proof.

perGoalDecisions.title: Die Aussagekraft chemischer Daten beurteilen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Judging data is a meaningful entry into trustworthy everyday chemical information.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The complete cross-reactive-test and temperature/matrix-control cases retain validity, uncertainty and bounded inference. This goal also serves Sek-I; the same anchor is explicitly in that composition view, so its legacy E metadata creates no new entry-stage prerequisite.

perGoalDecisions.title: Oxidationsprodukte von Alkanolen erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Changes of everyday organic substances can motivate oxidation-product reasoning.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Ethanol oxidation depth and the fresh secondary-alcohol case still require structure-to-product explanation under specified conditions. No universal acid formation or new carbonyl/alkohol gate is added.

perGoalDecisions.title: Nanoskalige Silikonoberflächen materialgestützt beurteilen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Useful surface materials provide a concrete technology and everyday-life motivation.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Both complete nanosurface cases retain independent film/particle dimensions, same-chemistry structure changes, equal-thickness controls and missing dirt/abrasion evidence. The edge supplies no nano-function guarantee or polymer-hydrolysis blanket prerequisite.

perGoalDecisions.title: Organische Moleküle mit Molecular Modelling darstellen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Computer models connect chemistry to things learners can explore and produce.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The existing molecular-geometry prerequisite stays exact. Own ethane/propene and benzene/toluene digital actions/files remain required; a supplied image or orientation completion cannot replace actual tool use.

perGoalDecisions.title: Glykosidische Bindungen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Sugar building blocks connect chemical structure to food and biological materials.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The carbohydrate-cluster prerequisite stays exact. Maltose/sucrose structures and hydrolysis/water-balance transfer remain; motivation cannot replace anomeric-centre or linkage-position reasoning.

perGoalDecisions.title: Oxidierbarkeit von Alkanolen vergleichen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Contrasting reactions of familiar alcohol structures is an appropriate curiosity entry.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The supplied primary/secondary/tertiary and fresh branched structures still require local OH-carbon C-H reasoning under comparable mild conditions. The new edge makes no unrestricted oxidation prediction.

perGoalDecisions.title: Recyclingstrategien abwägen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Material cycles and resource choices fit the anchor’s everyday and societal purpose.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Whole PET/PE cases plus hb208 energy recovery remain operative, including actual-function and system boundaries, source criticism and changed-mixture limits. No hydrolysis duty is dropped or universal prerequisite imposed.

perGoalDecisions.title: Einfache Bindungswinkel mit dem EPA-Modell erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Molecular shapes can motivate a learner to explore how chemistry explains material properties.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The angle-only cases intentionally provide all geometries/domains; model-angle reasoning and lone-pair deviations remain the increment. The edge does not restore the deliberately excluded duplicate geometry-classification assessment. This target and the same anchor are visible in Sek-I.

perGoalDecisions.title: Carbonsäuren beschreiben
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Acids in everyday materials provide a direct interest-based chemistry entry.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Both complete formula/indicator cases retain carboxyl recognition, homologous CH2 increments and acid/ester distinction. Orientation does not certify prior carboxyl knowledge or impose soap/carbonyl dependencies.

perGoalDecisions.title: BTL-Kraftstoffe über Fischer–Tropsch erklären
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Alternative fuel production gives a concrete energy/technology motivation.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The reaction-equations prerequisite remains exact. Complete hb201 gasification/cleanup/FT/upgrading, ideal C8 balances and coal/H2 transfer remain; no GK expansion, real plant execution or automatic carbon neutrality follows.

perGoalDecisions.title: Industrielle Zuckergewinnung prozessbezogen bewerten
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Sugar production connects chemistry to everyday products and production decisions.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: The supplied beet-process chain, comparable A/B data and water-loop C transfer preserve chemical separation/change, all three evaluation perspectives and uncertainty. The orientation neither chooses the result nor weakens process reasoning.

perGoalDecisions.title: Radikalische Substitution mechanistisch darstellen
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: The possibilities of changing molecules can motivate radical-chain chemistry.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Methane chlorination and independently constructed ethane bromination retain initiation, propagation, radical regeneration and actual termination plus product-purity limits. No experiment or chemical competence is certified by the orientation.

perGoalDecisions.title: Green-Chemistry-Metriken
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: Resource-efficient production provides a fitting relevance context for green-chemistry metrics.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Whole energy20-20 synthesis/formulation materials retain atom economy versus mixing, yield, input/waste boundaries, reaction water and function/toxicity/energy limits. No routine is replaced by motivation or universally required as a new scientific gate.

perGoalDecisions.title: Optische Aktivität und Polarimetrie auswerten
perGoalDecisions.orientationJustification: A learner can be curious about how chemistry characterises substances using light.
perGoalDecisions.wholeGoalAndPositiveEvidenceAssessment: Both amino-acid and carbohydrate cluster prerequisites remain exact. All five P cases plus complete polarimeter/glucose/fructose material retain device causality, sign/units, uncertainty, single-known-solute condition and mixture/identification limits; orientation does not supply measurement evidence.

graphAssessment: All 27 candidates preserve every prior direct scientific prerequisite in order and append only the existing prerequisite-free orientation. Both graphs have no requires/contains cycles or missing endpoints. No cluster prerequisite is added, so no blanket scientific skill family is silently imposed. This is a didactic relevance/engagement sequencing decision, not an official source requirement or a chemistry knowledge prerequisite.
positiveEvidenceAssessment: Whole positive profiles were read in their current input context. Supplied chemical material, model limits, fresh transfers and real-execution duties remain operative; the edge supplies none of the assessed content evidence. Exact normal P-owner records were compared to all27 frozen records. This is a bounded review of dependency/context compatibility, not another claimed first scientific completion or replacement for final P review-input binding.
